_doc: Ordered model fallback chains per agent — the single source of models; agent files carry no model ids. Rungs are tried in order on provider failure, dispatched by the conductor. Behavior-critical agents (conductor, deep, writing, plan-*) keep family-pure chains so their prompt always matches the family that serves them; cheap agents may mix families — their Core Directives are temperament-neutral, and direct use without the conductor falls back to the session model. ultrabrain and architect are deliberately family-coupled to a single rung: when the family is missing, the conductor reports it and routes to the nearest available agent with a flag in the rationale line.
